headline: U.S. Strikes Five Iranian Oil Tankers After Missile Attack
summary: The US confirmed striking five Iranian oil tankers after the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two American warships over two days. Peace talks have collapsed, and analysts warn of further escalation.
why: Attacks on oil tankers in the Gulf disrupt crude shipments and raise insurance and freight costs, directly affecting global oil markets.
why_moved: The US strikes on Iranian oil tankers and Iranian missile attacks on US warships, with peace talks collapsed, raise the risk of prolonged disruption to Gulf oil shipments.
